command: set -eu; echo HOST=$(hostname); echo USER=$(id -un); for d in /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo /home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-2.0 /home/ai-core-node/self-integration /home/ai-core-node/entityos-repo /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star; do if [ -e "$d" ]; then echo FOUND=$d; if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then echo HEAD=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD); echo BRANCH=$(git -C "$d" branch --show-current); echo DIRTY_COUNT=$(git -C "$d" status --porcelain | wc -l); echo REMOTE=$(git -C "$d" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || true); fi; fi; done; for f in /home/ai-core-node/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/unified.db; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo DB=$f SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$f"); fi; done; systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-local-bridge.service | sed 's/^/BRIDGE=/'
